scoring_justification: Main quantities (Poisson's ratio values) are reported by the agent; checker validates them against paper-reported values with tolerances and monotonic trend, as full recompute from raw simulation outputs is not available in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference ranges for Poisson's ratio at c=0% and c=14% derived from paper's abstract: -0.15(2) and -0.29(3) with ±0.05 tolerance.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's reported values and extended with generous tolerance to accommodate run-to-run variation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Based on the paper's own published results with tolerance to accommodate stochastic spread.

outputs.description: Poisson's ratio vs α for two system sizes; the checker computes the max absolute difference between the two curves to confirm overlap.
Poisson's ratio at α=0 for concentrations c=0%,5%,14%; values are compared to hidden gold tolerances and checked for monotonic decrease.

output_contract.notes: The accuracy of the simulations depends on implementation details and stochastic variation; the checker tolerates reasonable spreads while rejecting obviously wrong results.

steps.description: Maximum absolute difference between the Poisson's ratio curves for N=500 and N=2000 across all angles.
Checks that Poisson's ratio at c=0% and c=14% are within paper-derived ranges and that the values decrease monotonically with concentration.
